skills.name: change-dns-safely
skills.description: Change DNS for a domain at Porkbun without breaking it. Use when the user asks to add, edit or delete DNS records, point a domain or subdomain at a host (Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Pages, a server IP), set up email records (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC), change nameservers, turn on DNSSEC, or undo a DNS change on a Porkbun domain.
headings: Change DNS on a Porkbun domain safely
Pointing a domain at a host

skills.name: publish-website
skills.description: Publish a website to Porkbun Secure Static Hosting. Use when the user asks you to build, create, update or put live a website, landing page or placeholder page for a domain they have at Porkbun, mentions Porkbun hosting or static hosting, or asks how to upload site files to Porkbun.
headings: Publish a website to Porkbun hosting
